parameters.name: BundleUrl
parameters.description: The downloadable URL (HTTP/HTTPS) of the bundle.zip file. Mutually exclusive with SkillMdOverride. If provided, the bundle is replaced.

parameters.name: ExpectedVersion
parameters.description: The expected version number for optimistic locking. If not specified, the update is based on the current highest version.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Skill to update.

parameters.name: SkillMdOverride
parameters.description: The SKILL.md body content. Mutually exclusive with BundleUrl.

parameters.name: VisibilityScope
parameters.description: The visibility scope. The corresponding field is used based on the visibility level.
